# Jolpica F1 (Ergast-compatible) — returns

Columns of the FLATTENED frame the sdv-py parser emits per route: one row per element of the route's row path, scalars of every ancestor carried onto each row (intermediate arrays prefixed by their singular: `Races[].raceName` -> `race_name`, `Laps[].number` -> `lap_number`), nested objects joined with `_` in snake_case, a leaf that repeats its parent's name collapsed (`Driver.driverId` -> `driver_id`, `FastestLap.Time.time` -> `fastest_lap_time`). Arrays inside a row stay one stringified column. `type` is the JSON type on the wire: Ergast serializes EVERY value as a string, so the parser casts the columns described as integer / number. Generated by `tools/gen_openapi.py`; do not hand-edit.

## `/seasons.json`

Rows at `MRData.SeasonTable.Seasons[]`.

| col_name | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `season` | string | Season year (integer on the wire as a string). |
| `url` | string | Wikipedia URL. |
